description: Scaffold a Rust crate for one unit: napi-rs or wasm-bindgen bindings in src/lib.rs, stubs to port in src/port.rs, UTF-16 helpers when the unit uses string offsets. Never overwrites an existing folder.

allocator.description: Global allocator for crates with batches. mimalloc (default) is C and leaves wasm alone; rusty_alloc is pure Rust (no C compiler) and also serves wasm.

as_json.description: Type parameters the app only fills with data (`T` in `paginate<T>(items: T[])`): bridged as JSON values instead of keeping the export in TS.

batch.description: Batch classes, `function:param`: the function runs over many `param` values kept in Rust, on all cores, in one call. A `<Function>Index` struct in port.rs replaces the default per-item loop.

force.description: Bridge a unit the plan marks blocked or keep.

keep.description: Exports to keep in the source language: `name` or `name: reason`.

name: bridge
title: Scaffold unit crate
